claims.location_accuracy: Doire-an-lair old name unresolved (geometry null); Castlemaine/Dungarvan only town reference possible

claims.historical_event: Gaelic viewpoint of 3-day banquet betrayal by Essex, capture O'Neill, family and execution of unarmed retinue including women children, leaders quartered in Dublin.
claims.location_accuracy: Belfast general region; historical banquet house unknown

claims.historical_event: Sidney took Loughrea town, imprisoned Earl Clanricarde, appointed captains; 1580 annal says English constable Master Jones maintained Loughrea warders continuously until 1580 Burke recapture.
claims.location_accuracy: Loughrea historic town can use modern town Point, Tudor palisade not surveyed

claims.historical_event: Sidney troops took Castlebar from Edmond Mac William Burke after support for imprisoned earl's sons; local yearend uncertain and contradictory official loyalties require further study.
William Drury as Munster president executed various chiefs and commoners in areas near Limerick after military tour, including O'Brien noble relatives; exact villages and death counts unrecorded.
claims.location_accuracy: Limerick general city reference, execution spot unknown

claims.historical_event: Drury held court for eight days in Ennis, Dal Cais refused tribute; Drury left armed marshal and beheaded some chieftains around Limerick.
claims.location_accuracy: Ennis/Limerick urban region only; court building cannot be safely identified

claims.historical_event: English forces induced Laoighseach O'More branch under protection to Mullaghmast and killed Muircheartach and followers; AFM and Dowling list 1577, Carey uses older Gaelic manuscript and period chronologies supporting March 1578.
claims.location_accuracy: SMR KD036-008 historic Rath approximate [-6.85222,53.00993]; NO proved precise killing pit

claims.historical_event: A Malby subordinate took Leitrim from O'Rourke; local Burke/O'Rourke factions took it back with English consent; multi-side local political control not annual whole county occupation.
claims.location_accuracy: Leitrim old town Muintir Eolais identify modern Leitrim village carefully; exact castle unlocated

claims.historical_event: Despite explicit promise not to devastate Desmond's lands, armed Crown forces destroyed local people/cattle and burned corn/buildings in Munster.
claims.location_accuracy: Kilmallock military camp regional centre; burned farm villages not enumerated

claims.historical_event: After battle of Aenach-beag, Nicholas Malby destroyed Askeaton monastery and advanced on Adare; regional forces looted houses and cornfields on BOTH sides of conflict.
claims.location_accuracy: Askeaton abbey modern heritage reference point can be located, original wall not measured

claims.historical_event: English war council resolved to place warders at Lough Gur, Rathmore, Castle Maurice, Adare and Kilmallock castles. Annal describes a resolve, NOT separate contemporary confirmations each ward established and held 31 December.
claims.location_accuracy: town reference for some, Castle Maurice/Kerry Rathmore exact Tudor castle unlocated

claims.historical_event: Burke sons stormed Loughrea, freed prisoners and demolished fortress after English constable Jones had held English garrison since 1576; cross-decade closure for CH10.
